description: TLS certificate analyser daemon. For each HTTPS server in mcp_server_registry: use ssl + socket to fetch certificate: ssl.get_server_certificate((host, 443)). Parse with ssl.PEM_cert_to_DER_cert and x509 analysis. Extract: issuer, subject, valid_from, valid_until, san_domains, is_self_signed. Risk scoring: self_signed = -30 to domain_trust signal, expired cert = -40, cert valid <7 days = -20 (likely compromised rotation), mismatched hostname (cert CN != server domain) = CRITICAL, cert issued by unknown/private CA = -25. ws_write mcp_signal_scores domain_trust signal update with evidence. ws_write mcp_threat_associations for CRITICAL cert issues. Poll 43200s. Heartbeat.
